releases.new: Upsert rows into a table using the new upsert() method, which is built on MERGE INTO.
releases.breaking: Python 3.9 and PySpark versions below 3.5 are no longer supported; upgrade them, and check decimal types, since precision and scale are now inferred.

releases.new: Read Databricks streaming tables directly through the Databricks backend.
releases.breaking: Removed deprecated APIs such as ibis.case, String.to_date and Struct.destructure; switch to ibis.cases, as_date and Table.unpack.

releases.new: Build an Ibis schema directly from a SQLGlot definition using the new Schema.from_sqlglot method.
Call to_sql() directly on any expression to get the SQL it compiles to.
releases.breaking: Unpacking with overlapping column names now always overwrites existing fields; check code relying on the old behavior.

releases.new: Create specific UUID values in expressions instead of only random ones.
releases.breaking: Polars sum now returns NULL where it previously did not, matching other backends; check code that relied on the old sum result.
